swarm.name: The Drift
swarm.blurb: A rogue AI swarm has eaten the nation's measurements and is quietly rounding them off. Go in and take them back.

act.name: National Institute of Standards and Technology
act.note: A fan-made game inspired by public pages on nist.gov. Not affiliated with or endorsed by NIST. All art and text are original.
act.theme: The swarm has eaten the standards

crew.name: Wren
crew.blurb: Field medic. Keeps the crew running with thread and solder.
crew.look: a small field medic in a patched canvas coat, carrying a satchel and a large needle and thread

crew.name: Ox
crew.blurb: Shield bearer. Has walked out of worse.
crew.look: a broad shield bearer in riveted scrap armor with a huge round shield made from a hatch door

crew.name: Kestrel
crew.blurb: Breaker. Finds the seam in anything and pulls.
crew.look: a lean scout in a hooded jacket wielding a long crowbar

creatures.name: Drifting Kilogram
creatures.blurb: The swarm got into the standards from the second to the kilogram. This weight no longer weighs what it says.
creatures.look: a squat cylindrical brass laboratory weight with a knob on top, stubby legs, and an angry dented face

creatures.name: Faint Photons
creatures.blurb: Detectors were built to catch light this faint. Now it's catching you.
creatures.look: a loose flock of nine small pale yellow paper light sparks with tiny angry eyes, moving together as a group

creatures.name: Evidence Hound
creatures.blurb: Trained to collect and examine. The swarm taught it to keep what it finds, including your gold.
creatures.look: a lean grey hound with a large magnifying lens for one eye, carrying a stolen evidence bag in its jaws

creatures.name: Nanotube Serpent
creatures.blurb: Carbon nanotubes are among the site's emerging materials. This one learned to coil, wait, and strike.
creatures.look: a long coiled serpent made of a black hexagonal carbon lattice tube

creatures.name: Scattered Neutron
creatures.blurb: Fire a neutron beam at a sample and it scatters. Hit this one and it does the same.
creatures.look: a wobbling translucent pale green blob with concentric ripple rings and a dark core

creatures.name: Biofoundry Bloom
creatures.blurb: Grown in a corrupted biofoundry. It reproduces whenever you stop looking at it.
creatures.look: a carnivorous potted plant growing out of a laboratory flask, with curling vines and seed pods

creatures.name: Test Tornado
creatures.blurb: Part of the research on how buildings withstand tornadoes. It got out of the test and kept the building's roof.
creatures.look: a small airborne grey-blue tornado funnel carrying spinning shingles and splintered boards

creatures.name: Empty Lab Coat
creatures.blurb: Still reporting for work. There's nobody inside it, and it copies whatever it saw you do last.
creatures.look: a floating white lab coat with nobody inside, empty sleeves raised and a clipboard held in one cuff

creatures.name: Deadweight Engine
creatures.blurb: A force machine stacked with twenty equal weights. The swarm taught it to walk.
creatures.look: a towering walking steel machine built from a frame and a stack of huge round weights, with piston legs

creatures.name: Burn Test Salamander
creatures.blurb: It crawled out of the fire research lab, and it's been in the eye of the fire ever since.
creatures.look: a heavy orange and red salamander with scorched skin, wearing a burnt lab thermocouple harness, flames along its back

creatures.name: Wafer Spider
creatures.blurb: A semiconductor wafer with legs, walking off a production line that no longer exists.
creatures.look: a large spider whose body is a round iridescent silicon wafer etched with a chip grid, with thin wire legs

creatures.name: The Last Accurate Second
creatures.blurb: The swarm's heart in this site: a colossal clock that has decided what time it is. Every system still trusts it.
creatures.look: a colossal walking atomic clock tower of brass pipes and cooling coils, with a cracked glowing clock face for a head and massive piston arms

creatures.name: Calibrated Caliper
creatures.blurb: Freed from the calibration lab. It measures the gap in any armor, and it doesn't round off.
creatures.look: a friendly steel measuring caliper walking on its two jaws like a crab, with a round dial for a face

creatures.name: Rescue Beacon
creatures.blurb: Built to locate survivors in a collapsed building. It's still looking, and now it's found you.
creatures.look: a small hovering rescue drone with a warm amber lamp, four paper rotors, and a dangling first aid kit

events.title: The calibration storefront
events.text: The new calibration storefront is still taking orders, but the price list has been overwritten with teal digits.

options.label: Empty the till
options.result: Nobody stops you. Nobody is here.

options.label: Book a calibration
options.result: The bench still works. The crew feels true again.

events.title: An old radio station
events.text: A time-signal transmitter hums in a back room, still broadcasting. The swarm's been listening to it, too.

options.label: Jam the signal and learn how

events.title: The mass spectral library
events.text: Shelves of chemical fingerprints, half eaten. One entry describes exactly how to flush the swarm out of a system.

options.label: Sell the shelf's index
options.result: Someone, somewhere, still pays for these.

events.title: A blog post about laughing
events.text: A performance excellence blog insists that a little enjoyment is always important. The swarm has only eaten the second half of the jokes.

options.label: Finish the jokes yourselves
options.result: They're terrible. The crew feels better anyway.

options.label: Keep moving
options.result: Nobody laughs. You make good time.

events.title: The burn room
events.text: Fire testing has deep roots here. The burn room door is hot, and there's a lockbox on the far side.

options.label: Run through for the lockbox
options.result: You come out richer, smelling of soot.

options.label: Vent the room first
options.result: It takes a while. The crew sits and breathes.

events.title: Standard reference materials
events.text: Rack after rack of sealed samples, each one the exact thing it says it is. In here, that's rare.

events.title: A small business grant
events.text: An abandoned partnerships office still has an award letter on the desk, made out to whoever's holding it.

options.label: Read the fine print
options.result: Buried in clause nine: Last Stand.

events.title: A post-disaster survey
events.text: A resilience team's field kit sits where they left it, with notes on how communities recover after the worst has passed.
